text:
oscar_cs: Quick triage - Ember's trial run showed intermittent 429s during SDK init. They spin up ~200 short-lived processes that call preflight rapidly.

oscar_cs: Logs: 
```
POST /v1/preflight 429 - x-req: e3b2 - user-agent: Ember/2.0 python-sdk
POST /v1/generate 401 - reason: token_missing
```

oscar_cs: They said their auth gives tokens with TTL 5s.

jenna_sdk: Oof - TTL 5s + per-request refresh = stampede. Recommend local token cache with TTL floor of 20s. Also suggest exponential backoff on 429.

mike_se: Can we provide a temporary per-tenant burst window? We can open an infra ticket for a 45m allowance.

oscar_cs: Asked customer to switch to caching. They reported green after switching to a pool that reuses tokens for 30s.

ops-bot: INF-4927 created by mike_se: "burst allowance for tenant ember - 45m"

oscar_cs: Capturing as onboarding note: server-side SDKs should warn if token TTL < 10s and suggest caching.

jenna_sdk: Filed RD-2044: "SDK token TTL warning and TokenCache convenience constructor."

oscar_cs: Thread resolved, moving to post-onboard check in 2 days.
